d: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut has expressed his willingness to apologise to the Supreme Court over his remarks concerning Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and the judiciary. The controversy erupted after the CJI declined to meet an Opposition delegation seeking to raise concerns over alleged irregularities in voter lists and the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.
